notice: Adapts xPRISM pricing to the Chainlink AggregatorV3 interface. Derives xPRISM/USDC price from the chain: xPRISM -> PRISM (ERC-4626) -> USD (1:1 soft peg assumption) -> USDC (USDC/USD feed) Formula: xPRISM_USDC = xprism_prism * D8 / usdc_usd

title: xPrismOracleAdapter
author: [Zharta](https://zharta.io/)
details: PRISM is priced at its 1 USD soft-peg target (PRISM -> USDO -> USD), not at market price. No on-chain feed anchors this assumption, so a PRISM or USDO depeg is NOT reflected in the reported price. See the README section on xPRISM depeg risk.
